missing_information_behavior: Do not calculate a formula or dose without session duration, conditions, product sodium/potassium content and relevant medical history.
safety_exclusions: Do not assume all electrolyte products are equivalent.
Do not recommend excess fluid intake or a fixed replacement volume.
Do not use high-sodium/potassium products without reviewing kidney, heart and medication risks.
professional_escalation_conditions: Kidney disease, heart failure, hypertension, fluid restriction, heat illness symptoms, confusion, collapse or persistent vomiting.
population_and_context: People undertaking prolonged exercise with high or very high sweat loss; electrolyte replacement may be relevant depending on duration, environment, individual sweat losses and product composition.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Individualize fluid and sodium strategy to event and sweat losses; distinguish sodium from potassium and follow sports-medicine guidance.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance materials provide general exercise context; sports hydration recommendations require protocol-specific appraisal.
